'''Venom Zero'''&mdash;also known as "'''VZ'''"&mdash;was a [[Venom assault squad|squad]] of [[Venom assault trooper]]s that served the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Considered to be an elite unit, Venom Zero was not permanently assigned to any one [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|''Sabertooth''-class assault/rescue vessel]] like its fellow [[Squad/Legends|squads]] but was constantly transferred between [[Starship/Legends|ships]] when the mission deemed that the unit was needed. Like other Venom assault squads, Venom Zero was trained in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|close-quarters combat]], zero-[[Gravity/Legends|G]] combat, and ship-to-ship boarding tactics. When not engaged in battle, Venom Zero was responsible for training its fellow squads in advanced combat techniques.

==Description==
Like other Venom assault squads, Venom Zero was suitably equipped for boarding actions and close-quarters combat. Standard equipment included [[Venom Assault armor]], which was [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]-sealed powered [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with limited [[Jetpack/Legends|jump jet]] capability for maneuverability in zero-G; [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]]; [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]]; and [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun]], [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion]], and [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenades]]. Floating [[Surveillance droid/Legends|surveillance droids]] were also used to scout enemy positions or used as [[Programmer/Legends|programmable]] weapons platforms.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
[[File:Venom_assault_trooper.jpg|thumb|right|135px|A Venom assault trooper]]
Venom Zero was an elite [[Venom assault squad|squad]] of [[Venom assault trooper]]s assigned to the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] in [[137 ABY]], serving during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Like all Venom assault [[Squad/Legends|squads]], Venom Zero&mdash;also known simply as "VZ"&mdash;specialized in [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-to-ship boarding actions, zero-[[Gravity/Legends|G]] combat, and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand fighting]]. Deployed from [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|''Sabertooth''-class assault/rescue vessels]], Venom assault squads breached enemy vessels when their [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] used the "teeth" on the bow of the craft to latch onto opposing ships. Squads would then pour into the captured ship from multiple breach points, subduing enemy resistance and securing objectives.<ref name="LECG" />

While most Venom assault squads were permanently assigned to a single ''Sabertooth''-class vessel, Venom Zero had no permanent base of operations and was instead constantly moved around the ships in the Core [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]], being assigned to whichever vessel needed its expertise the most. When not actively employed in combat, Venom Zero provided advanced training to the squads aboard the ship on which it was currently deployed.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
